name: @linkurious/create-ogma
description: Create an Ogma project from a build system template.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare.mjs && node scripts/install-templates.mjs && concurrently "npm run build:vite" "npm run build:rollup" "npm run build:webpack" "npm run build:typescript" "npm run build:node" "npm run build:parcel" "npm run build:react" "npm run build:vue" && node scripts/cleanup.mjs
scripts.setup-templates: node scripts/prepare.mjs && concurrently "npm run install:vite" "npm run install:rollup" "npm run install:webpack" "npm run install:typescript" "npm run install:node" "npm run install:parcel" "npm run install:react" "npm run install:vue" && node scripts/cleanup.mjs
scripts.build-templates: node scripts/prepare.mjs && node scripts/install-templates.mjs && concurrently "npm run build:vite" "npm run build:rollup" "npm run build:webpack" "npm run build:typescript" "npm run build:node" "npm run build:parcel" "npm run build:react" "npm run build:vue" && node scripts/cleanup.mjs
